beats.title: Open everyday tools
beats.narration: PocketShell keeps your terminal central. Actions brings the everyday tools within reach.

beats.title: Save a reusable command
beats.narration: Save a command once. Named fields let you reuse it with fresh values.

beats.title: Review before running
beats.narration: The preview shows the exact command. Insert types it. You choose when to run it.

beats.title: Read the actual result
beats.narration: The shell prints the message literally, including the apostrophe and the dollar expression.

beats.title: Find and copy output
beats.narration: Search finds retained output. Move between matches and copy the line you need.

beats.title: Keep the terminal untouched
beats.narration: No match? You get a clear empty result, and your terminal stays untouched.
